description: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports - Regulations Made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports under Sections 32 & 33 of Sports Law No. 25 of 1973
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, which constitutes legal/regulatory matters. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to suspend registrations and appoint a competent authority, falling under the category of regulatory frameworks and legal instruments rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
